## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Colorful user-interface design uses vibrant, high-contrast palettes and
gradients to create engaging, memorable, modern user experiences.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: high-contrast, playful, premium
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Inter, display=Inter,
  mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 8pt baseline grid

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Vibrant, high-contrast palettes and gradients for engaging, memorable, and
modern user experiences.
